entry.name: bucket
entry.digest: Pass numbers from outlet to outlet
entry.description: Outputs incoming values to outlets in bucket-brigade fashion. bucket acts as an n-stage shift register which can shift its contents from outlet to outlet in either direction.

arguments.name: outlets
arguments.description: Sets the number of outlets. If there is no argument, there will be one outlet.

arguments.name: output-flag
arguments.description: A second non-zero argument sets theobject to "echo to output" mode, whereby the number received in the inlet is stored and sent out the left outlet when it is received. This makes it somewhat easier to visualize the data coming from the outlets.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: All stored values are sent out, but their position is not shifted.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Reset internal values without causing output
messages.description: Themessage resets the internal values ofwithout causing any output.

messages.name: float
messages.description: The numbers currently stored inare sent out, then each number is moved one outlet to the right and the new number is stored to be sent out the left outlet the next time a number is received.

messages.name: freeze
messages.description: Suspends theoutput, but new incoming numbers continue to shift the stored values internally.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The numbers currently stored inare sent out, then each number is moved one outlet to the right and the new number is stored to be sent out the left outlet the next time a number is received.

messages.name: l2r
messages.description: Setsto shift its stored values from left to right (the default) whenever it receives a number in its inlet.

messages.name: L2R
messages.description: Setsto shift its stored values from left to right (the default) whenever it receives a number in its inlet.

messages.name: r2l
messages.description: Setsto shift its stored values from right to left whenever it receives a number in its inlet, placing the incoming number in the rightmost outlet.

messages.name: R2L
messages.description: Setsto shift its stored values from right to left whenever it receives a number in its inlet, placing the incoming number in the rightmost outlet.

messages.name: roll
messages.digest: Use the end value as input
messages.description: The word, followed by any number, causesto use the value stored in its rightmost outlet as input; thus, it sends its output, shifts all stored values to the right, then stores the value which had been in the rightmost outlet in the leftmost outlet (as if it had been received in the inlet).

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Store and output one value in all locations
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sends that number out each outlet, and stores the number as the next value to be sent out each of its outlets.
